computer_tool_listing:
usage: rclone-copy <tool> [--argument value ...]   (rclone-copy <tool> --help for its arguments)

tools:
  operations-about             Get remote quota — Returns storage quota and usage details for the remote, equivalent to `rclone about`.
  operations-check             Compare source and destination — Compares source and destination trees, reporting matches, differences, and missing files.
  operations-cleanup           Remove trashed files — Permanently removes trashed objects from the specified remote path.
  operations-copyfile          Copy a single file — Copies one object from a source remote and path to a destination remote and path.
  operations-copyurl           Copy from URL — Downloads a public URL and stores it at the requested remote path.
  operations-delete            Delete objects in path — Deletes matching files and directories for the provided remote, honouring filters and config overrides.
  operations-deletefile        Delete single file — Removes a specific object from the remote.
  operations-fsinfo            Describe remote capabilities — Returns backend features, hash support, metadata descriptions, and other info for the remote.
  operations-hashsum           Generate hash sums — Produces a hash sum listing for files under the given path using the requested hash algorithm.
  operations-hashsumfile       Hash a single file — Returns the hash of a single file using the specified hash algorithm.
  operations-list              List objects — Lists objects and directories for a remote path, returning the same fields as `rclone lsjson`.
  operations-mkdir             Create directory — Creates the target directory or container if it does not exist.
  operations-movefile          Move a single file — Moves one object from a source remote and path to a destination remote and path.
  operations-publiclink        Create or remove public link — Creates a share URL for an object or removes an existing link when `unlink=true`.
  operations-purge             Purge directory — Deletes a directory or container and all of its contents.
  operations-rmdir             Remove empty directory — Deletes an empty directory or container.
  operations-rmdirs            Remove empty directories — Deletes empty subdirectories beneath the specified path, optionally leaving the root.
  operations-settier           Change storage tier — Updates the storage class or tier for every object in the specified remote path.
  operations-settierfile       Change file storage tier — Updates the storage class or tier for a single object.
  operations-size              Count remote size — Reports total size, file count, and number of objects without size metadata.
  operations-stat              Stat an object — Returns metadata for a single file or directory, mirroring `rclone lsjson` on one entry.
  operations-uploadfile        Upload files via multipart — Accepts multipart/form-data payloads and writes the uploaded files to the specified remote path.
  sync-bisync                  Bidirectional sync — Performs a bidirectional synchronisation between two paths, supporting safety checks and recovery options.
  sync-copy                    Copy source to destination — Copies objects from a source remote to a destination remote without deleting destination files.
  sync-move                    Move source to destination — Moves objects from a source remote to a destination remote, optionally cleaning up empty directories.
  sync-sync                    Sync source to destination — Synchronises a source remote to a destination remote, making the destination match the source.
usage: rclone-read <tool> [--argument value ...]   (rclone-read <tool> --help for its arguments)
